topic: DogStatsD packets from other containers dropped
environment: Several app containers on the same Docker network
symptom_pattern: Custom metrics from every application container are missing, although the apps are configured with the Agent's service name. Metrics sent from inside the Agent container with a test command work.
root_cause: DD_DOGSTATSD_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC is false (or unset where the base config disables it), so the Agent's DogStatsD server only listens on localhost and drops packets coming from other containers.
resolution_path: Compare a test packet sent from inside the Agent container with one from an app container
Set DD_DOGSTATSD_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC=true and restart the Agent
info_needed: whether a test metric from inside the Agent container works

qa_pairs.tse_question: Does a metric sent from inside the Agent container show up?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, I ran echo into nc inside the agent container and that metric appeared.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the Agent's environment variables (minus the API key)?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: We have DD_DOGSTATSD_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC=false because our security team said to lock things down.

customer_style.tone: cooperative, technical, slightly defensive about security settings
